description: This simple yet powerful card is the result of several iterations done with the input of business users in different industries. It is designed to show on one sight a KPI and how it compares to the other two references (i.e. other KPIs, or comparisons). The frame of the card changes according to predefined boundaries. The comparison measures can have an arrow, and the colour behaviour of it depends on if the positive value is good or bad for the organization.
